Name: Duration
Description: Duration of the thermal erosion process.

Name: Strength
Description: Strength of the thermal erosion process.

Name: Anisotropy
Description: Thermal erosion's anisotropy that affects how rock is affected, and deposits formed. See the Anisotropy section for details.

Name: Sediment Removal
Description: Amount of sediment to be removed.

Name: Feature Scale
Description: Scale of the largest feature in the terrain.

Name: Real Scale
Description: Use the scale defined in the terrain. Disable to access addtional options and modify erosion's physics.

Name: Terrain Scale
Description: Scale of the terrain. Available when Real Scale is turned Off

Name: Verticality
Description: Height of the terrain.Available when Real Scale is turned Off
